title: openai: /v1/chat.completions parity - params, roles, stop/logprobs, streaming & response formatting
author: Avery Chen
description:
Goal: Bring Redwood's /v1/chat.completions compatibility layer to parity with OpenAI semantics for params, roles, stop sequences, and logprobs; improve streaming stability for tool/function calls and structured output formatting. Motivation: customers using OpenAI-compatible clients expect identical behavior (roles mapping, stop handling, logprobs presence) and robust streaming when using function/tool calling. This PR implements the remaining parity surface, fixes edge cases observed in canary traffic, and adds end-to-end smoke tests.

Scope:
- Map OpenAI 'messages' roles -> internal speaker roles deterministically and support custom role strings.
- Implement OpenAI-style 'stop' handling: multi-token stops, prioritized stop order, and correct token-level truncation with consistent finish_reason.
- Expose 'logprobs' (top_k) when requested, including stable output shape and partial streaming behavior.
- Streaming: stabilize chunk boundaries during function/tool call streaming and ensure structured output chunks are emitted as valid JSON fragments for downstream parsers.
- Response formatting: apply OpenAI-compatible content assembly for streaming and non-streaming paths (content, role, delta chunks).

Checklist:
- [x] Role mapping and validation implemented
- [x] Stop-sequence priority + token-accurate truncation
- [x] Logprobs surface added (top_k param) + unit tests
- [x] Streaming chunk reassembly fixes for function/tool calls
- [x] Structured output helpers for JSON tool responses
- [x] E2E compatibility tests against openai-compat fixtures
- [x] Perf regression tests (no measurable latency regressions under 95th pctl)

Notes and links: linear tasks ENG-1289, ENG-1312. See docs: https://redwood.dev/docs/openai-compat and internal runbook for streaming failures: https://go/redwood/streaming-runbook. Related PRs: pr-93412 (previous parity pass), pr-92011 (streaming backpressure fix).
commit_summary: Squash of 7 commits: implement role mapping (+validation); stop sequence algorithm; logprobs top_k plumbing; streaming chunk stabilization; structured output helper; tests + fixtures; docs updates.

release_notes: OpenAI compatibility: chat.completions parity - roles handling, stop sequence accuracy, optional logprobs (top_k), and improved streaming stability for function/tool calls. No breaking changes to existing Redwood API; opt-in via openai_compat flag.
post_merge_notes: Deployed to canary on 2025-02-20; monitored 72h with no regression. Gradual rollout to prod completed 2025-02-24. Metrics: streaming error rate dropped 82% on canary traffic for function/tool-heavy routes.
testing_notes: E2E tested with openai-compat fixtures and live canary traffic. Added unit and integration tests. Benchmarked under 100RPS, 1k token contexts to ensure no perf regression beyond 5% median latency.
risk_regressions: Low. Changes isolated behind openai_compat toggle and covered by smoke tests and perf suite.
author_commentary: This PR is focused on parity, not feature expansion. Follow-ups: additional compatibility for response_format param and extended logprob metadata per ENG-1450.
